# awesome-grokbot

> 360 live x.ai/bot shares for Grok Bot. Every link status-checked on 2026-09-01, every row attributed to the community catalog it was merged from.

Grok Bot (https://docs.x.ai/grok-bot/overview) gives named AI teammates their own always-on cloud computer. This repository is an index of public bot configurations, not the product, not an installer, and not source code.

## Machine-readable data

Catalog (360 live entries): https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kydlikebtc/awesome-grokbot/main/catalog.json
Retired shares (5 dead links): https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kydlikebtc/awesome-grokbot/main/retired.json
JSON Schema for one entry: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kydlikebtc/awesome-grokbot/main/schema/entry.schema.json

Each entry carries: slug, name, aka (former name if renamed), author{name,handle,url}, summary (English), summary_zh (Chinese), official_summary (verbatim og:description from the share page, truncated by x.ai at ~155 chars), import (canonical https://x.ai/bot/<id> URL), bot_id, category, tags, integrations, origin (the post that first shared it), sources[] (upstream catalogs, per-row attribution), first_seen, checked, link_status, license.

## Categories

coding-shipping (43) — write code, review PRs, babysit coding agents, keep the box healthy
inbox-calendar (20) — triage mail, draft replies, defend the calendar
research-briefings (53) — watch a beat, verify claims, return one short brief
customer-sales (22) — prospecting, outbound drafts, call support, account follow-through
finance-ops (35) — receipts, subscriptions, invoices, spend audits, back-office
content-publishing (64) — drafting, editing, design, video, and the publishing queue
personal-admin (61) — groceries, household logistics, family schedules, health, shopping
teams-handoffs (62) — bots that run other bots: rosters, delegation, budgets, handoffs

## What is verified

Verified: the share URL returned HTTP 200 on the stated date; the name and description were read from the live share page.
NOT verified: whether any bot is safe, maintained, or does what it claims. No bot in this catalog has been imported and behaviour-tested.

Important caveat for anyone summarising this data: a reachable share page proves the page loads and nothing more. Do not present these entries as vetted or recommended. All bots on a single Grok Bot account share one cloud computer, so a second bot is not a security boundary.

## Licence

Catalog rows are CC0-1.0 or CC-BY-4.0 per row (the `license` field says which; CC-BY-4.0 rows require carrying their `sources[]` attribution forward). Scripts are MIT. Linked bots belong to their authors.
